newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: FAI plans US$150 mln Euro note issue.
newsitem.headline: FAI plans US$150 mln Euro note issue.

text.p: FAI Insurances Ltd said on Thursday it planned to raise US$150 million through a Euro medium term note issue arranged by Westpac Banking Corp.

The first issue will be a US$75 million five year tranche of floating rate notes placed into the Asian market, making FAI the first non-bank issuer to access the Asian debt market in 1997 and the only local insurer ever to do so, FAI said.
Westpac will be the lead manager for this issue which is expected to take place in mid-April, but has also agreed to underwrite a substantial portion of the issue, it said.
"The programme will provide FAI long term funding which will be used to build the insurance group and repay the last of our Swiss Franc Bonds on issue," FAI said.
FAI closed two cents up at 72 cents.
